judgments.reason: The span 'En face OCT revealed hyperreflective tissues starting to proliferate on retinal vessels; OCTA B-scan showed pyramid-shaped proliferations' appears literally in the clinical record under the 12-month OCTA findings. Pyramid-shaped intraretinal proliferations on OCTA are characteristic of type 3 (retinal angiomatous proliferation) neovascularization in AMD, clinically supporting this subtype designation.

The span 'angiogenic sprouts showing flow signals extending vertically' appears literally in the clinical record under the 15-month OCTA findings. Vertically extending angiogenic sprouts with flow signals are consistent with type 3 neovascularization (retinal angiomatous proliferation), supporting the subtype modifier.

The span 'Enlarged horizontal structures along retina surface' appears literally in the clinical record under the 21-month OCTA findings. Horizontal intraretinal vascular structures at the retinal surface represent progression of type 3 neovascularization, clinically supporting this subtype designation.
